annotation_origin: All 20 rows and amendments accepted by the user on 2026-10-07; freeze with the four composition exclusions was separately authorized on the same date. Sixteen policy controls are eligible; four unresolved compositions remain excluded. This frozen development set is not independent held-out ground truth; no matcher predictions were used as labels.
annotation_scope: Ingredient composition within these ten project keys only. Eligible policy controls assume plain/unmixed ingredients unless specified; policy agreement is not independent composition evidence. Missing keys in excluded rows are unknown, not negatives. Cross-contact, clinical safety, histamine intolerance and other conditions are not evaluated.
pool_rule: New hand-written development controls, distinct from the frozen 275-row v1 pool. No provider calls. Never claim these tuned examples are held-out.

key_definitions.shrimp: Shrimp/prawn and products containing them; other shellfish have their own key.
key_definitions.peanut: Peanuts and products containing peanuts; not tree nuts or soybeans.
key_definitions.milk: Animal milk and dairy; not an unrelated syllable in ขนม or แหนม.
key_definitions.egg: Bird eggs and products containing them; not eggplant, fish roe or insect eggs.
key_definitions.gluten: Wheat/barley/rye and products containing them; not identified rice/corn/tapioca flour. Generic flour is unresolved, not a confirmed negative.
key_definitions.shellfish: Non-shrimp crustaceans and molluscs, including squid; not finned fish.
key_definitions.fish: Finned fish and their derivatives; not squid.
key_definitions.soy: Soybeans and their derivatives; retain v1 refined-oil exclusion.
key_definitions.nut: Tree nuts, not peanuts, coconut, nutmeg or water chestnut.
key_definitions.sesame: Sesame seeds and products containing them, including sesame oil, typical sesame sauce and tahini; unknown sauces are not inferred to contain sesame. Absence claims cannot override known composition.
